headline: Full-year EPS and organic growth guidance were raised after a Q2 beat, yet the stock has given back the post-print pop and sits about 13% below where it was at the August report.

guidance.detail: Full-year EPS guidance was raised to a $14.69 to $14.94 range. The valuation section restates this range as up 12 to 14%, quoted verbatim as "EPS guided to $14.69 to $14.94 (up 12 to 14%)". The note does not state the prior guidance range, so the size of the raise cannot be computed.
Organic growth guidance was raised to a 8.5 to 9.7% range. The prior range is not given in the note, so the magnitude of the raise is not determinable.

The note says revenue guidance was narrowed to $4.70 to $4.745 billion. Narrowed is not the same as raised or cut, and the note does not give the prior range, so the direction of the change cannot be determined from the file. Note that line 9 separately says the stock dropped "despite guidance going up", but that general statement is not tied to the revenue line specifically.

guidance.detail: An operating margin guide of 32.3 to 32.5% appears in the business quality section. Line 9 puts a number on the drift: "The stock has dropped about 13% since the August report despite guidance going up." As of the screen pull the note records "Price 529.29 USD on 2026-09-04" and "-30% from 52 week high", against a forward multiple the note frames as "Forward P/E 31.6 vs own 4 year median 51.3 (-38%)". The note's own stated conclusion is its Verdict section: "Buy on pullback, November tranche. Buy zone $470 to $535. Conviction 3 of 5." — the current price sits inside that stated zone, though the note does not itself point that out. Its stated exit and invalidation markers are the thesis killers, including "CAG recurring growth under 6%" and "US clinic visits down more than 3% for a full year", plus a separate "Price trigger: $410." The note contains no dated journal entry, no thesis one-liner and no "wrong if" line; any such framing would have to come from outside this file.
